arguments.sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_usd DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Lists the five users with the highest total transaction amount, with the total in dollars, highest first.
assumptions: 'Spent' means the sum of all transaction amounts per user, across all transactions whether or not they carry a fraud label.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, not treated as refunds and not excluded.
Each transaction is attributed to the user who owns its card (transactions.card_id -> cards.user_id -> users.id).
Ties in total are ordered by user id ascending.
Total is returned in dollars (cents divided by 100).
